incident-bot: [ALERT] Streaming p99 latency spike detected for inference-serving (us-west). p99 jumped from 180ms -> 3.2s in the last 5m :rotating_light:
andrea: noticed alerts ~5m ago, routing errors + backpressure on several pods. customers on Dedicated observed degraded streaming responses.
devon: checking dashboards — streaming p95 ~700ms, p99 ~3.2s, tail >5s on some hosts. Errors are mostly `KV cache miss` + occasional `page-fault` logs.
mike: any deploys/rollouts in the last hour?
andrea: yes, CI rolled kernel-compilepath v2.14 into runtime nodes ~35m ago to pick up TRT8 flashattn patch.
jess: that's the new compiler flag set (--opt-compile=flashquant) we toggled in rollout.
andrea: linking deploy logs — https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/8675309
ashley: I've got a host with a stack trace, looks like persistent decode stalls in lla_decode loop, paging activity high: ```
[2026-03-15T10:12:21Z] decode: alloc page fault -> evict -> recompile kernel path
[2026-03-15T10:12:22Z] warn: continuous batching stall (streaming)
```
devon: correlating with kernel change: when we switched kernel-compilepath v2.14 we changed how shared kernels are linked; saw a small mem-pressure bump in canary. Might be causing cross-container paging.
mike: are these Dedicated-only or also Hosted?
andrea: majority impact Dedicated in us-west and a small subset of Hosted streaming traffic hitting the same nodes.
jess: customer impact: two paying customers reported slow completions and some timeouts on streaming RPCs. Escalating to CS.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-14 (priority: P1)
andrea: mitigation plan: 1) pause kernel rollout, 2) roll back nodes to kernel v2.13 on hot path, 3) enable KV cache bypass for streaming traffic to avoid page churn, 4) monitor p95/p99 and error rates.
devon: I'm starting a targeted rollback for the pool that houses dedicated us-west nodes. Doing a staggered drain->rollback on 3 nodes now.
mike: I'll open a temporary reroute; add routing policy to prefer us-east for new streaming sessions while rollback happens.
jess: adding a rule in routing service: `if endpoint == streaming and region == us-west then prefer us-east` — applied.
andrea: running quick diag script on affected host: ```bash
ssh host-122
sudo perf record -a -g -- sleep 5
sudo perf report | head -n 50
```
ashley: perf shows heavy kernel->userspace transitions in the compilepath component. Page-fault counts elevated: PFIN=~1200/s vs baseline ~2/s.
devon: that screams compilepath linking thrash. FlashAttention/ TRT kernels are repeatedly being linked/evicted.
mike: rollback status?
devon: 1/3 nodes rolled back, after rollback p99 on that node dropped from 3.1s -> 210ms within ~60s.
andrea: good sign. Continue rolling back remaining nodes. Also propose we toggle `--runtime-eviction-threshold=0.8` to be less aggressive temporarily — will reduce recompile churn.
jess: toggled threshold on staging, looks stable. Planning to apply to live after rollback completes.
ashley: CS update: notified impacted customers, offering postmortem + timeline. Affected customers asked for ETA on fix.
mike: after remaining nodes roll back, I'll re-evaluate whether to pin model variants for Dedicated to avoid hot kernels.
andrea: deploy-bot: rollback job started by devon: job/rollback-1767778888 -> nodeset: redwood-dedicated-usw.
deploy-bot: job/rollback-1767778888: node host-122 rolled back -> kernel v2.13 (ok)
deploy-bot: job/rollback-1767778888: node host-123 rolled back -> kernel v2.13 (ok)
deploy-bot: job/rollback-1767778888: node host-124 in progress
devon: host-124 complete, all three rolled back. Observability: p95 now ~160ms, p99 ~250ms across pool. Error rate for streaming RPCs down to baseline.
andrea: mitigation effective. Next actions: 1) keep kernel v2.13 pinned for production pools for 24h, 2) reproduce in staging with heavier streaming KV cache load and the new compile flags, 3) file bug with compilepath team (assign to @devon and @ashley), 4) run a controlled canary with TTL for kernel v2.14 after fix.
jess: opened ticket INF-6789: "compilepath v2.14 causes streaming paging thrash with flashquant flag" assigned to devon, priority high.
ashley: capturing logs + perf profiles and attaching to INF-6789. Also adding sample requests that hit the path.
mike: customer sync scheduled at +30m with CS to confirm service restored and offer follow-up.
andrea: oncall handoff: I'm staying on for next 30m to watch metrics, then hand off to devon who will own next 12h until full root cause.
devon: ack. I'll prepare a focused test plan: heavy streaming sessions with repeated short-lived contexts, KV cache disabled to reproduce.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0315-14 status -> mitigated (p95/p99 back within SLOs, customer impact isolated, rollback performed).
andrea: postmortem: schedule 72h post-incident. Root cause hypothesis: new kernel-compilepath linking + flashquant compile flag interactions cause frequent kernel evictions under streaming KV cache patterns, leading to page faults and long tail decode stalls.
jess: agreed. Action items: triage compile flag interactions, add a canary with synthetic streaming load before future kernel rollouts, and update runbook to include immediate rollback and routing reroute steps.
andrea: handing off now to devon for long-window monitoring. devon: please coordinate with compilepath team and post the RCA draft here.
devon: taking over — will post updates in this thread. Marking thread resolved for P1 active mitigation. :white_check_mark:
